batting.name: J Fraser-McGurk
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b JC Archer

batting.name: Abishek Porel
batting.dismissal: c R Parag b PWH de Silva

batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: run out (PWH de Silva, Sandeep Sharma)

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b JC Archer

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b M Theekshana

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b Kuldeep Yadav

balls.text: Sliced up and Theekshana drops a sitter! This is short and wide, stays low. Stubbs loses his balance as he reaches out. The ball goes high and Theekshana settles under it at backward point. But makes a meal of it to frustrate Sandeep Sharma even more!
Bouncer is closer to the batter this time, swatted down to long-on again
Slower wide bouncer, Stubbs manages to pull it off the toe end to the long-on fielder
Into the stands! Sandeep is going wayward now, and bowls another full toss on the stumps. Stubbs has no problem smashing this over cow corner!
Too full, too straight and punished! Stubbs whips this free hit away in the gap behind square!
Full toss on leg this time, and he clips it out to deep square leg. But wait, Sandeep has overstepped! Free hit coming up!
Another wide! This time it's a wide bouncer gone wrong. It just slips out of his hand and goes very wide
Now goes for a yorker around leg, Ashutosh looks to clip it away and it slides down. Wide again
Slower bouncer outside off, Ashutosh looks to ramp but misses. Immediately reviews for wide not given. Ashutosh was on his toes at the crease trying to play that. And that's given wide!
Full outside off, pace off, and Ashutosh misses out as he looks to go inside out
Sandeep starts off with a wide! Not quite yorker length but that was what he was attempting. Just past the tramline
Full around middle and leg, Ashutosh looks to heave it away but misses. Goes square off his pads and they take the leg bye
Bouncer outside off, Ashutosh goes across but doesn't attempt a shot in the end due to the height on that. Wide called by the umpire
Excellent from Ashutosh! Short ball angled into him, Ashutosh backs away and opens the face to glide it over the keeper! And well fine of short third
Yorker down leg, following Stubbs who had backed away. He manages to open his face and squeeze it out to short third for a quick run

Superb innovation from Stubbs! Goes well across the stumps and Archer follows him with a pace-off length ball. Stubbs waits on it and then scoops it fine on the leg side with enough power to clear the short fine leg fielder
On a length outside off, Ashutosh goes back to pull it out to deep midwicket
Starts off with a wide yorker, but Ashutosh manages to open his face and squeeze it fine on the off side! Beats short third and gets a boundary
Yorker just outside off, as he spots Ashutosh move across his stumps. Ashutosh manages to squeeze it into the vacant midwicket area for a quick single
On a length outside off, Ashutosh punches it behind point. The deep point fielder runs to his left and makes a good stop. Hetmyer was the fielder
Slower ball on a length and quite wide. Ashutosh looks to cut, but it's too far for him. Too far for the umpire's liking as well

Bouncer around off, Ashutosh looks to ramp. Doesn't seem to connect but this time Samson appeals rather animatedly! And they review it too! Ashutosh's bat was up like a periscope, but he survives as UltraEdge confirms there was no contact with the ball. It swooshed by very close!
Sandeep sticks to slower bouncers outside off, Stubbs again goes across and pulls it to the leg side for a single

Yorker around off, Ashutosh hits a picture-perfect straight drive but it goes back to the bowler, who can only deflect it past the stumps at the non-striker's end. That was technically a chance for Sandeep, but it was very low and he only got his fingertips on that
Dug in short outside off, slower ball of course, Stubbs waits and pulls it out to deep midwicket

Holes out this time! Invaluable cameo comes to an end. It's another full toss and he looks to go down the ground but he hits it too flat and Jurel grabs it running in from long-on. Axar punches his helmet, while it's still on, as he walks out, but he's really injected some much needed momentum into this innings
Picks the gap beautifully! Theekshana goes a bit short around middle, Axar clears his front leg and hammers a pull square of the deep midwicket fielder!
Axar is here on a mission! Low full toss outside off and he slices it over backward point! Reached out and got it over the fielder
Dropped a bit short outside off, Stubbs backs away and looks to clatter it on the off side, but picks out the extra cover fielder on the circle
Drills it in flat and full outside off, Axar pulls it off the inside half of the bat and gets it wide of long-on
Fires in a full toss across Axar, who is quick to move across his stumps and pulls this all the way behind square leg!
Dropped by Parag! Full, but flatter around off. Stubbs can't get underneath it as he goes downtown. No elevation on that and Parag running in from long-on dives in front, but can't hold on!
On a length around middle and off, Stubbs whips it between deep midwicket and deep square and they get two
Dropped a bit short around off and Axar just slaps it out towards long-off
The fielders don't matter for this one! In the slot outside off, and he gets on one knee and slogs it over cow corner! He has picked Hasaranga as his match-up and taking him on
Now Hasaranga overcompensates and bowls it too full, outside off, and Axar hammers a drive wide of long-off. Playing the field well here, is the DC captain
Hasaranga drops it short and Axar capitalises! Rocks back and pulls this quite straight of Hetmyer at deep midwicket. Hetmyer dived while running to his right but Axar has done enough to beat his man
Slower bouncer angled across Axar, who waits on it and slaps it out to deep cover
Back of length around leg, Axar backs away and cuts it straight to backward point
Length ball outside off, punched away through cover. Another single for DC
On a length on leg, steered down to deep third
Slower bouncer outside off, Stubbs waits on it, gets on his toes and swats it along the ground to deep midwicket
On a length on leg, clipped out to deep backward square
Legbreak on a length around middle and leg, Axar tucks it square on the leg side

Porel falls the next ball he faces after getting that life! It's one that's going on with the angle and Porel looks to go down the ground. Ends up hitting it off the toe end and Parag takes a few steps in from long-off and pouches it!
Looks to slash a legbreak outside off and it goes to Theekshana at short third on the bounce as he slices it. But he lets the ball through, allowing a single
Massive! Tossed up full outside off, a bit too full, and Stubbs is quick to slog-sweep this all the way over deep midwicket
Oh beauty! Full outside off and it rips off the surface, spinning past the outside edge as Stubbs pushes at it!
Googly outside off, Stubbs goes back and punches it to short cover
Short ball angled across Porel, who sways back and tries to ramp it, but no luck. Replays show that Porel did in fact get some bat on that, but Royals never appealed!
On a length around off, Stubbs just gives it a gentle nudge towards mid-on and gets a single to start off

Holes out to deep midwicket! It's a back of length delivery, not short enough to pull maybe, but Rahul has to pull the trigger. Tries to hammer it on the leg side but gets no elevation on it. It goes flat to Hetmyer, who grabs it just inches above the ground! Royals continue to impose themselves on this ground and Archer gets Rahul for the first time in the IPL!. That was a legcutter from Archer
Bumped in short around off, Rahul barely moves as it sails over him. Wide called immediately
Short and angled across him, Porel swivels and pulls it out along the ground behind square leg
Low full toss on middle and Porel can't capitalise! Whips it wide of long-on but the fielder gets there
Dug in short outside off, Rahul pulls it square on the leg side
Porel did try for the big shot but it doesn't come off. It's full around leg and he whips it to deep midwicket's right
Parag tosses it wide of off, and Rahul cuts it out to the off side sweeper
Full on middle, Porel comes down the track before clipping it through midwicket
On a length around leg, tucked through midwicket for a single
Tossed up full around middle, Rahul eases it to cover
Bursts through the fielder! Floated very full outside off, Porel hammers a drive to point where the fielder can't hold on
Full outside leg, eased to short fine for a single
Offbreak on a length on middle, steered to backward point
A drag down on leg, following Rahul who backed away. Rahul rocks back and pulls in front of square
Clears long-off! This is in the slot outside off, Rahul clears his front leg and lofts it stylishly down the ground. The fielder was leaping but Rahul got enough elevation on that
On a length angled across him, Porel cuts it fine but can't find the gap between backward point and short third
Theekshana tosses this on a length and wide of off. Rahul reaches out and cuts it away to deep cover point
cut away to deep-backward point. On a length, and wide-ish of off already, before turning away further. Porel waits, before slashing at it for four
this drifts away, and is full and outside off. Porel looks to drive, but misses again
very full on middle and off, as it dips on to Rahul. Driven to long-on
another googly, but this one is quicker, and pitching on a fullish length on off. Punched to long-off by Porel
ohh, beaten! Much slower from Hasaranga, who tossed it up and bowled full and outside off. It turned away as Porel looked to loft, and missed
On a length on middle, and turning away. Pulled to long-on
again bowls short and just outside leg to Porel, who opens his stance up before looking to pull. But he misses, and is hit on his body
again Rahul backs away, and this time Theekshana follows. He bowls full and outside leg, and Rahul clips to deep midwicket
shorter side to the left-hander too, but this lands outside leg. It turns away slightly, and Porel mistimes a pull towards deep-backward square leg
short in length again, but this pitches around off and turns in a bit. Punched to long-on

misfield at deep cover, and four!! Jurel was the man there moving to his left, but let the ball slip through after himself sliding on the field. It was a carrom ball from Theekshana, as Rahul made room early, and slapped hard at it
short of a length on middle, and Rahul nudges it towards midwicket. It was played softly, and Theekshana gave the chase, by which time the batters ran two
on a length, and just outside off. It turns away, and Rahul punches to deep cover
much fuller around off, and pushed towards cover by going low
the wrong 'un from Hasaranga, who bowls slow, and gets it to dip on a fullish length on middle. The ball ends around off, and is punched to long-on
full and slow, and around fifth stump. Swept to deep midwicket
very full again, as Hasaranga gives the ball some loop. It is just about on off, and Rahul drives on the bounce to the man at extra cover
tosses it up, and bowls quite full on leg stump. Driven hard to long-on by Porel
a low full angling across, and coming on to Porel just outside off. Swiped wide of long-on for a single
a bouncer on off, and Rahul opens his stance up to swat-pull to deep midwicket. He did well to ride the bounce there
launched down the ground. Rahul has a free swing of the bat at this length delivery angling in and arriving just outside off, and clearing his front leg also helps him crash the ball
slower ball, and on the shorter side around fifth stump. The ball shaped in to finish closer to off, and was punched to point
bowls this from wide of the crease, and goes short around middle. The ball shapes away to finish wide of off, as Porel pulls to deep midwicket with his bottom hand coming off
on the shorter side of a length, and angling in to pitch on off. Pushed to long-on by closing the face of the bat
shorter side of a length on middle, and punched to long-on with a big swing of the arms from Rahul
another low full toss after an attempted yorker, and this time Porel drives from middle and off to mid-on for a hurried single
Sandeep switches to a short delivery outside off, and Rahul rolls his wrists to pull to deep midwicket
excellent execution from Sandeep, as he nails another yorker. Rahul makes room and skips down the pitch, and can only manage to drag this ball arriving around off to mid-off
another yorker which shapes into Porel, although this one comes around off. He jams his bat down in time to clip towards square leg
an inswinging yorker arrives on middle, and Porel gets his front leg out of the way to squeeze it back to Sandeep
fullish ball on middle and leg, and nudged off his pads towards square leg
advances down the pitch, and gets a leading edge towards cover point. The ball was on the shorter side on middle and off, and was a carrom ball, which Rahul looked to clip
whipped to deep square leg. It was a high-ish full toss, and arriving just outside leg. Even Rahul seemed surprised by that, although he played it well to bag four in the vacant region
very full - nearly a yorker - and drifting into middle. Driven to extra cover this time
on the shorter side of a length, and quicker around sixth stump. Pushed towards cover point
full and dipping on leg, and flicked to deep midwicket
clipped to deep square leg, as this full ball swings back in to arrive very full, and on the stumps

good work by Parag at mid-off. He tumbles to his right to keep this to a single, after Rahul skips down and drives at this length ball in the channel outside off. Parag may have saved at least a run or two there
on the shorter side of a length, and angling in, as Sandeep bowls this from close to the stumps. Rahul dabs it down from off stump
drives this fuller ball outside off to long-on
almost a copy of the last ball, except for the run-out! Another bottom edge as Porel looked to pull a shortish ball, and the ball went behind the wicket

A mix-up between Nair and Porel... and replays show Nair is juuuuust short of the crease at the non-striker's end! This is what happened earlier: Sandeep angled a length delivery into the left-hander from around the stumps, and pitched it around off. Porel went for the pull, bot got a bottom edge on to his leg. The ball trickled away towards backward point, and while Porel was looking at the ball, Nair was already halfway down the pitch. The throw went to Sandeep, and Nair was late in turning around

ohh, almost taken at square leg! The ball fell just short of the man there, after Nair took his eyes off for a second, before realising that this short ball didn't get up as much as he would have liked. He went for the pull off this 145kph delivery, mistimed it, and nearly fell
short ball, and Nair ducks! Archer bangs the ball on middle, and has Nair ducking, even as the ball finishes around leg stump for the keeper
on a fullish length, and just outside off. Dabbed to point with a firm sound off the bat

a golf swing, but taken! Jaiswal, at extra cover, moves a few steps to his left, and takes it in front of his stomach. JFM hardly got any timing there, as Archer bowled on a short of a length on middle and off. His front leg was out of the way, and he seemed to have been by the pace and bounce as much as his own lack of technique, with his head facing down the ground.
short delivery around middle stump at 145kph, and Porel is nearly beaten for pace. He plays an unconvincing pull towards deep square leg
on a fullish length on middle, and Porel only manages to push it back towards Archer
a single to end the over! Quite a miracle! A slow full toss around middle, and Porel clips to deep square leg
pulled to deep midwicket! Deshpande looks clueless, while Porel bats like a boss! A short ball rising around off or thereabouts, and Porel rolls his wrists to pull along the ground for four more
four more! Porel reads the slower ball too! On a short of a length, and pitching just outside off, before shaping away. Porel plays late, and slashes at it to deep-backward point

wow, superb shot! An effortless pick-up whip! The ball lands deep into the stands at deep-backward square leg. It was a fullish ball from Deshpande, but on Porel's pads. Porel simply waited, before dispatching it for six
some luck for Porel, and four runs for DC! He skips down the pitch, and as this length ball angles across to pitch outside off, Porel gets an outside edge wide of the keeper as he looks to hoick
chipped wide and over mid-on! Deshpande angles it across, and ends up bowling a lowish full toss around middle and off. Porel adjusts for the dip, and swipes at it across the line
shortish in length on leg, and Porel slightly opens his stance up to nudge to deep-backward square leg
tighter line this time. Shorter side of a length around off, and seaming in. JFM punches towards cover for a quick single

one-bounce, and four over cover! Archer again bowls a length delivery, although this is closer to off than the previous ball. JFM lofts without really getting to the pitch of the ball, but that's his style, really
sliced aerially to deep point! He opens the face of the bat at this length delivery which is wide of off, and with Archer getting now swing, JFM throws his bat and gets four
no foot movement from JFM, who leans into a drive off this fullish ball slightly wide of off. But the ball trickles to mid-on off the inside half of the bat
a sharp inswinger first ball! It starts from well outside off, but finishes full on the pads, as JFM clips towards the man at square leg

Tucked to midwicket, and they don't get the second! We're going to a Super Over! Starc nails a yorker again, Jurel can only tuck it to deep midwicket and the fielder does well to run in and throw it back to Rahul, who has all the time in the word to take the bails off before Jurel makes it back. Mitchell Starc, you beauty!
In the blockhole, Hetmyer swings it away to long-on. They get one. And Jurel sends Hetmyer back when he wants the second!
Sliced in the air, and they get just two! Misses his length this time and he is able to slap it away over cover
This time they get two! Starc manages another one in the blockhole but Hetmyer is able to push it out to deep cover! Great running
Nails the yorker outside off. Jurel is able to squeeze it to Starc's left for a single. Oh my, this is thrilling stuff!
Goes for the yorker and Hetmyer is able to dig it out into that midwicket region! Gets a single
Slower short ball, flat-batted down to long-on. Just the single this time
Short on off and going across, pulled in front of square and they do well to run two! The throw is at the striker's end, but I think Hetmyer was in by the time Rahul takes the bails off
Full, just outside off, swung away along the ground wide of long-on

Clears Stubbs at long-off! Slower ball but Jurel was waiting for that. Smacks it down the ground and gets enough elevation. Stubbs leaps with one hand sticking up but he can't get anything on that. Jurel is pumping his fist

High, and almost taken at the boundary! What a save! Full outside off, Jurel has a swing towards deep midwicket. The sub fielder is falling back as he grabs it above his head and throws it back in. Mohit is angry he didn't take the catch, but to be fair, that wasn't easy to catch!
Full and wide, Hetmyer manages to swat it out to deep midwicket
Oh, nails the wide yorker, does he? Nope! Just past the line according to the umpires!
Full on the stumps, Hetmyer clips it out through square leg

Oh, so unlucky for Starc, so lucky for Hetmyer! Goes for the yorker again, gets it to tail in, but Hetmyer just gets enough of an inside edge on it to deflect it past leg stump! And it goes for a boundary to add salt to the wounds
Starc nails the yorker and up goes the finger! That tailed back into Rana. 144kph toe-crusher! Rana isn't bothering with the review. He had a whip across the line but misses. Classic Starc!
Jurel backs away as Starc goes short and pulls it out to wide long-on
Full toss on the stumps, punched out to mid-on
Goes for the yorker just outside off, Jurel gets it off the inside edge through square leg. Just a single

Gets this over the infield and it races away! It's on a length around off, Rana goes across the stumps and looks to scoop it but doesn't hit it well. Kuldeep running back from short fine can't get there. He puts in the dive to keep it out but can only help it onto the ropes. Rana brings up a 26-ball half-century! And Kuldeep may have hurt himself there
On a length outside off, Jurel waits on this and cuts it out to deep point
Full ball outside off, and it stays low as Jurel reaches out for it
Pummelled into the stands! Full toss on the stumps and Jurel whips it square! That will get him going!
Slower bouncer around leg, Rana swivels and pulls it out to deep square leg on the bounce
Back of length outside off, Jurel pulls it down to long-on
Googly on a length around leg, Jurel eases it out to deep midwicket. Royals well set now after that over

Given immediately! Jurel consults with Rana and reviews. This was full around middle, spinning away slightly. Jurel went for the sweep and missed. Hit on the back pad. Oh, that's missing! On height, and going past the off stump as well! Jurel survives, and Kuldeep doesn't get the wicket, after going for runs in this over
Full on middle, drifting into Rana, who sweeps it out to deep backward square
Connects the reverse-sweep this time! Kuldeep tries to throw it wide and keep it out of Rana's arc, but he reverses it and just gets enough on it to get it past Rahul!
Rana skies it and he's hit it far enough as well! Too short on off and Rana rocks back to nail the pull over midwicket
Tossed full on middle, eased out to long-on
Hammered down the ground! Right in the slot on middle and leg, Rana clears his front leg and lofts this back over the bowler
Big shout for lbw as Rana misses his switch-hit attempt. Keeper isn't interested. They opt not to review. Think that pitched outside leg.
Jurel clips this lenkgth ball through midwicket for a single that brings Rana back on strike
Axar angles this full ball across Rana who misses his sweep. The ball bounces off Rahul and allows the bye
And now the edge goes for four! Rana throws his bat at this delivery tossed on a length and going across him and that's gone past the keeper
Stubbs can't hold on at long-on! It's short-ish outside off and Rana flat-bats it down the ground. Stubbs has his arms outstretched above his head at the rope but it bursts through his hands!
On a length on leg, tucked down towards long-on. Five runs and a wicket. Excellent over
On a length around middle, it's a wrong'un. Jurel hang back in his crease and clips it out to deep midwicket
Floated up on leg, Rana skips out and eases it through midwicket
On a length outside off, he hangs back and tucks it down to long-on

That man Kuldeep Yadav delivers again! Floated full on leg, Jaiswal gives charge and can't get the requisite power behind that. Simple catch at long-on and Delhi Capitals are right back in it! Kuldeep brings out a celebration on his tiptoes, can't quite say what he was going for there, but he's got a big wicket for his team. And with the pressure building over the last three overs, you could see one of the batters looking to go big!
Tossed full around middle, Rana sweeps it behind square to the fielder in the deep. Nigam fumbles it but they don't risk a second
Hit on the pads as he swipes across the line. Length ball, pace off, around leg and it deceives the batter
Slower ball yorker around off, Rana laces it along the carpet to long-off
Full around middle, driven out to long-off
Tucked out to deep midwicket. This was a yorker on the legs, Rana did well to squeeze it out

Big appeal as Rana has a swipe across the line to this length ball on leg going across him. The ball goes behind to Rahul, who graps it and he appeals. DC send it upstairs. It doesn't touch his bat, just goes off his thighs to Rahul. Review lost
Slapped away in the gap! Length ball outside off and that's wide enough for Rana to hoist over cover. One bounce and four
Short ball angled across him, Rana frees his arms to cut and gets it off the toe end. Goes to deep point on the bounce
Yorker just outside off, Jaiswal opens his face as he jams his bat down and steers it to short third. Gets his third half-century of the season. In fact, his third in the last four innings!
On a length and going across, pace-on this time, and Rana cuts it away to deep point
Short on middle and leg and going across, the pace-off delivery sticks in the surface. Jaiswal waits on it before helping it out to deep midwicket
Full around middle, he eases a drive to long-off
Starts off with a pace-off length ball around middle, Jaiswal clips it out through midwicket
On a length around off, punched down the ground to long-on
Legbreak floated on a length outside off, Jaiswal reaches out and cuts to backward point
Floated full on off, Rana taps it through point for a single

What a save! This is a long hop down leg, Jaiswal rocks back and pulls it behind square. Mohit Sharma in the deep runs to his left, leaps and parries it back in before falling back over the rope. Stunning effort
Floated full outside off, Jaiswal looks to drive this down the ground but it comes off the inside edge, onto the ground and back to the bowler
Kuldeep starts off this over with a full toss but Rana can only flick it out to deep midwicket
a low full toss around sixth stump. He drives at it, but gets an outside edge to short third. Jaiswal is unhappy about Rana not going for a single, as he says "bhaago yaar!"
reverse swept to deep cover. He switches early, and Stubbs ends up bowling a low full toss outside leg
inside out loft over extra cover. A bit of Suresh Raina there, as he leans into the shot off this full and dipping ball outside off
full and quicker, and on the stumps. Driven to long-off
over long-on! Stubbs bowled full and slow on off, and Jaiswal sent it miles up for six even as the ball hinted to turn away
on a fuller length, and just outside off. Cut away to point
similar ball to the last one, as it comes just outside off. But this time Jaiswal punches it to long-on
slower from Axar, who bowls on a length, and just outside off. Jaiswal punches it back towards Axar
drilled to deep square leg! Jaiswal went low and pumped this slog sweep off this full ball on leg
slower, and on a length just outside off. Slashed to deep third
angled across, and bowled on a length just outside off. Pushed back by Rana

Bowled him! It is Axar's first wicket of the season, and it is a fine delivery too. He angled it in from around the wicket, and bowled pretty slow and on a length on middle and off. The ball straightened after pitching, as Parag looked to push forward from off. But the ball went through to strike the stumps after beating his outside edge
six down the pitch. Jaiswal skips down the pitch, and converts this dipping delivery on off into a low full toss. The ball was clubbed over Kuldeep's head
ohh, nice turn back in. Slow again from Kuldeep, who bowls slightly shorter on off. The ball ends on leg, and is clipped to deep midwicket
wrong 'un from Kuldeep. He slows it down, and goes on a length on middle. The ball finishes on off, and is blocked down by Parag
swept away to fine leg. Kuldeep bowled quicker, and full on middle. It dipped on to Parag, who swept it from the stumps
angled across, and on a length around sixth stump. Parag looked to jab but was beaten
this keeps a little low off a full length on off, even as it straightens. Parag gets a leading edge towards point
on a shortish length, and wide of off. Jaiswal slaps it towards point
great work by Axar diving to his left, as Jaiswal punched at this ball and took off for a single
angled across, and fullish and around sixth stump. He looks to slash, but is beaten
fuller and slow on off, and driven to long-off
another near chip towards extra cover! Axar bowls slow, and on a length on off, and again Parag pushes at it tentatively
angles this across, and bowls fullish and on leg. Clipped to deep square leg
nearly spooned to the man at extra cover!! Nigam slowed it down, and bowled on a length around off. The ball turned away, and was flat-batted by Parag wide of long-off
this dips on a fullish length just outside off, and is blocked down by Parag
slower, and full around off. Pushed forward aerially towards cover
lofted to long-off's right, as the ball moves and slides to stop the ball. The ball was full and around off, and Samson is clearly in pain after smashing the ball
this is quicker from Nigam, who bowls fullish and slightly wide of off. Samson looks to slash, but is beaten. And we get to know that it's a no-ball, as if Samson really needed a free hit
bang! Another big six from Samson tonight! Short again from Nigam, who bowls on the stumps, and Samson gets his front leg out of the way to hammer the ball over square leg
pulled to long-on. Nigam starts with a short ball on middle and off, and the ball doesn't turn either way. Samson shifts his weight back, and clobbers the ball
yorker around off, and driven to extra cover

dropped chance by Ashutosh! The ball went up a few hundred miles into the night sky, and Ashutosh, who was placed at midwicket, came forward while watching the ball fall, but the ball tickled his fingers and dropped off as he stretched his hands out. That happened after Samson went hoicking at a full ball which was bowled slower than usual. And surprisingly, the batters didn't even run
another yorker from Mohit, who's keeping Samson in check this over. The ball swings in to arrive on off, and Samson manages to jam his bat down at it
lofted to mid-off's right. Shorter side of a length, and a bit wide of off. But Samson has given himself room to punch that, and does that well wide of the fielder
a yorker just outside off, and Samson squeezes it out back to Mohit
on a length, and just outside off. Samson drags himself away, and drives to mid-off
very full, and swinging in towards off. Pushed aerially towards long-on
change of pace again from Mukesh, who bowls on a length on middle, and gets the ball to straighten. Punched to long-on from deep in the crease
Mukesh goes for the yorker, but ends up swinging it in and bowling a low full toss on middle and off. Jaiswal opens the face of the bat to drive to cover point
slower ball from Mukesh, and full and just outside off. Samson looks to swing across the line again, but this time gets it off the bottom of the bat to long-on, who just went out before this ball
Samson follows Jaiswal in thumping the ball. He is, as has been the case today, pretty deep in the crease, before heaving this shortish ball just outside off wide of long-on
Mukesh spots Jaiswal hinting to come down the pitch, and bangs it short and just outside off. Jaiswal rides the bounce and taps towards point
there is a man out at wide deep third, and he cuts it off after Jaiswal hacks at this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump. That makes it 19 runs off the over
full and swinging in to arrive on middle and leg. Whipped by Jaiswal to deep square leg for two more
big wide outside off! Starc angles it across, and bowls full and wide of off. Jaiswal lets it go, and it is called wide
flung over midwicket. This time Jaiswal goes across the line, as Starc bowls on the shorter side, and just outside off, and Jaiswal gets his front leg out of the way before slamming at the ball
wow, Jaiswal is in the mood today! He stands deep in the crease, gets slightly across, and hammers the ball over deep square leg with a pull, as Starc bowls short and on the stumps
slapped between point and cover point! My first impression was that it wasn't time very well, but he did find the gap. Short of a length from Starc, who goes wide of off, as Jaiswal plays it late
wide outside leg. This is angled in, and lands beyond the pitch. Rahul takes it on the bounce to his right
good stop by Rahul. He leaps and collects he ball on the bounce, as Jaiswal went to cut at this length ball just outside off, but got a bottom edge
short in length around off, and dabbed down by Samson
Samson shifts his weight back, and punches this short-of-a-length ball on off to mid-on
on the shorter side of a length, and on off. Tapped towards point for a quick single
the cameraman loses track of the ball!! Massive hit for six, and the ball is gone! Mukesh angles this in, and bowls on a length outside off. Jaiswal clears his front leg, and dumps it down the ground
on the bounce to Mohit at square leg. Another short ball from Mukesh, but this is around off. It doesn't get up a lot, and Samson mistimes his pull this time
swung away over fine leg! Mukesh bowls short on off, and gets it to angle in. Samson pulls hard and high from middle and leg, and sends Mukesh for six first ball
chipped on the bounce to Axar's left at mid-on, as Starc bowls full and slants it across towards off
he is standing deep in the crease, and leans into this push drive off a full ball angling across and arriving a bit wide of off. The ball goes towards cover
a yorker, but the line is outside leg. It clips Jaiswal's pad as he looks to flick it away, and Rahul does well to dive to his right and get a hand. The ball rolls away for a leg bye
this swings in, and lands on a length just outside off. Jaiswal ends up pushing it towards midwicket off the inside half of the bat
sharp movement off the pitch. Starc goes on the shorter side of a length, and wide of off, before the ball finishes wider still, even as Jaiswal looks to slash but misses
this swings away, and lands on a length around sixth stump. Driven hard to extra cover
